name: vietnam_blockchain_legal_topics
description: Targeted discovery topics for Vietnamese legal, regulatory, and policy discussions on blockchain, crypto assets, and virtual assets.
target_audience: Web3 founders and crypto builders in Vietnam
Legal and compliance counsels specializing in fintech/blockchain
Crypto investors and institutional market participants in Vietnam

topics.name: Resolution 05 & Crypto Market Pilot
topics.summary: Discussions on Government Resolution 05/2025/NQ-CP establishing the 5-year pilot framework for crypto asset trading, domestic exchange licensing, and charter capital requirements.
topics.watch_query: "Resolution 05", "Nghị quyết 05", "tài sản mã hóa", "crypto pilot vietnam"

topics.name: Law on Digital Technology Industry (Digital Assets Legal Status)
topics.summary: Analysis and public debate on the Law on Digital Technology Industry (passed mid-2025, effective Jan 1, 2026) granting civil property status to digital and virtual assets.
topics.watch_query: "Luật Công nghiệp công nghệ số", "tài sản số", "digital assets vietnam"

topics.name: Decree 284 Enforcement & Unlicensed Exchange Sanctions
topics.summary: Trending reactions and community concerns over Decree 284/2026/ND-CP imposing VND 30M-50M administrative penalties on domestic users trading on unlicensed offshore exchanges.

topics.name: National Blockchain Strategy & VBA Initiatives
topics.summary: Prime Minister Decision 1236/QD-TTg on the National Blockchain Strategy toward 2030, government infrastructure pilots, and Vietnam Blockchain Association policy advocacy.

topics.name: Crypto Taxation & Circular 15 Accounting Standards
topics.summary: Debates around Circular 15/2026/TT-BTC guidelines, digital asset corporate accounting standards, capital gains tax, and corporate compliance for Web3 companies.
